source: 581 Gap
target: 581 Hiatus

source: Upon witnessing the descent of the thick bluish‐green vines, Lumian marveled as if a real carriage could traverse their expanse.
target: Cum descensum vitarum densarum virido‐caerulearum conspexisset, Lumian admiratus est, quasi currus verus per earum spatium transiret.

source: It felt like a journey back to a scene from a few years ago when he would listen to his sister’s nighttime fairy tales.
target: Videtur iter esse ad scenam abhinc paucis annis, cum sororis fabulas nocturnas audiret.

source: The dazzling, dreamlike scene and boundless imagination seemed to materialize in reality at that very moment.
target: Scaena radiosa et onirica, atque imaginatio sine finibus, videbantur in re isto ipso momento se materialiter ostendere.

source: Ultraman Lato Guiaro sensed imminent danger.
target: Ultraman Lato Guiaro periculum imminens sensit.

source: The individual capable of such an effect couldn’t be a Low- or Mid-Sequence Beyonder; they had to be a Saint who had unlocked the door to godhood. Perhaps even beyond Sequence 4!
target: Individuum tale efficere non potuit esse Beyonder ex serie inferiori aut media; debuit esse Sanctus, qui ianuam divinitatis aperuerat. Forsitan etiam ultra Sequence 4!

source: Another formidable demigod had entered the scene!
target: Alius semideus formidolosus in scaenam intravit!

source: Who could it be?
target: Quis hoc esse possit?

source: Where had they emerged from?
target: Unde apparuerant?

source: This certainly wasn’t Gandalf.
target: Hoc certe non erat Gandalf.

source: While others might be unaware, Loki had thoroughly investigated the president of the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society, discovering he was a Beyonder of the Warrior pathway—a Warrior who had a penchant for research and mysticism.
target: Dum alii fortasse nesciebant, Loki diligenter investigavit praesidem Societatis Inquisitionis Papionum Crispatorum, detegens eum fuisse Beyonder in via Bellatoris — bellatorem qui studium inquisitionis et mysticismi habebat.

source: In the blink of an eye, Lato Guiaro spotted a black shadow racing down the thick green vines.
target: In instante, Lato Guiaro animadvertit umbram atram, quae per vites densas virido‐caeruleas celeriter descenderet.

source: It was an enormous pumpkin drawn by numerous gray mice.
target: Erat cucurbita ingens, a plurimis muribus cinereis trahente.

source: A hole atop the orange pumpkin resembled a coach.
target: Foramen in summo cucurbitae aurantii instar carri videbatur.

source: Within, a vaguely discernible woman sat, adorned in a purple robe, with crystalline heels adorning her feet.
target: Intus, mulier vago modo percepta sedebat, induta toga purpurea, et calceis crystallinis ornata.

source: A pumpkin coach, mice-drawn carriage, crystal heels—WHAT THE FUCK IS THAT!?
target: Currus cucurbitae, carrus ab muribus cinereis tractus, calcei crystallini — QUID DIABOLICUM EST ISTUD!?

source: Who could it be?
target: Quis hoc esse possit?

source: Lato Guiaro’s pupils dilated, and he couldn’t help but inwardly curse with the same words he used most frequently before transmigration.
target: Pupillae Lato Guiaro dilatatae sunt, et intus maledixit his ipsis verbis, quae ante transmigrationem maxime usurpare solebat.

source: Isn’t that Cinderella?
target: Nonne illa Cinderella est?

source: Did Roselle actually pen this fairy tale?
target: Num Roselle vere hanc fabulam scripsit?

source: Why hadn’t it gained traction, remaining unknown to most?
target: Cur non usque ad favorem pervenit, manens plurimis incognita?

source: For a fleeting moment, Lato Guiaro grappled with uncertainty, unable to discern whether the newcomer was a demigod aligned with another faction or a concealed powerhouse within the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society.
target: Per brevem momentum, Lato Guiaro cum incertitudine luctatus est, neque distinguere poterat utrum novus adveniens semideus sectae alterae consociatus esset aut arcana potentia intra Societatem Inquisitionis Papionum Crispatorum latens.

source: Regaining his composure, he cursed his ill fortune and prepared himself for a confrontation with the enigmatic demigod.
target: Compositum animum recuperans, fortunam infaustam suam maledixit et se ad congressum cum semideo mysterioso praeparavit.

source: Luckily, being the Governor of the Sea, he could at least temporarily impede the other party in these aquatic surroundings.
target: Felix, gubernator maris, saltem pro tempore adversarium in his aquatis circumstantiis impedire poterat.

source: Prior to the impending clash, Ultraman Lato Guiaro turned his gaze towards Mad Lady.
target: Ante certamen imminens, Ultraman Lato Guiaro oculos convertit in Mad Lady.

source: He didn’t have time to speak, but his eyes expressed the unspoken message: “Hurry up! No time for games!”
target: Non tempus habebat loquendi, sed oculi eius tacitam nuntiationem efferebant: “Festina! Nullum tempus ludis!”

source: Mad Lady swiftly grasped Ultraman’s urgency and, with a blink, positioned herself at the entrance of the energy passageway.
target: Mad Lady celeriter percipuit urgentiam Ultraman et, in ictu oculi, se ad introitum viæ energiae collocavit.

source: However, instead of materializing precisely there, she outlined her presence.
target: Sed pro eo ut ibi exacte apparuisset, praesentiam suam delineavit.

source: This decision was prompted by the sudden appearance of Mr. K and Lumian, seemingly having “teleported” nearby, with their sights set on the energy passageway’s entrance.
target: Haec electio orta est ex subita apparitione Domini K et Lumian, qui quasi in propinquia teleportati, oculos in introitum viæ energiae fixos habebant.

source: Splash!
target: Splash!

source: Whether from the imposing weight of the humanoid Sealed Artifact or Lato Guiaro raising his right arm, conjuring a mountainous azure wave, the water around the cave visibly swayed, teetering on the brink of collapse.
target: Utrum ex grave pondus Artificii Sigillati humanoidi aut a Lato Guiaro dextram manum levante, fluctum caeruleum montuosum evocante, aqua circa speluncam manifeste agitata est, in limine ruinae vacillans.

source: In that critical moment, “Cinderella,” seated in the pumpkin carriage, pushed open the door and rose to her feet.
target: In illo momento critico, “Cinderella”, in curru cucurbitae sedens, ostium aperuit et in pedes surrexit.

source: She extended her arms, and a massive iron-black cross materialized behind her.
target: Bracchia sua protulit, et ingens crux ferro nigro post eam apparuit.

source: The weight of the cross proved challenging for “Cinderella” to bear, as though it carried the concentrated sins of the entire world.
target: Pondus crucis “Cinderellae” ferre difficillimum evasit, quasi peccata totius mundi condensata afferret.

source: A cross?
target: Crux?

source: Ultraman Lato Guiaro was caught off guard as an empty room materialized before him.
target: Ultraman Lato Guiaro inopinanter obstupefactus est, cum conclave vacuum ante eum apparuerit.

source: Within the room, candlelight flickered, revealing a long table adorned with flesh and blood.
target: Intra conclave, lumen candelae micabat, revelans mensam longam in carne et sanguine ornatam.

source: On either side of the table, three obscure figures hunched over, gnawing and feasting on a gruesome banquet.
target: Flanque mensae, tres figurae obscurae incurvatae erant, manducantes et devorantes convivium horrendum.

source: Abruptly, the three figures turned their heads, fixing their gaze upon Lato Guiaro.
target: Subito, tres figurae capita converterunt, oculos in Lato Guiaro figebant.

source: He stood frozen, as if their gazes had penetrated his deepest secrets, dismantling them into the essential components of spirit and flesh.
target: Stetit immobilis, quasi oculi eorum arcana eius profunda penetravissent, dissipans ea in elementa essentialia spiritus et carnis.

source: A chilling sensation surged from the depths of Lato Guiaro’s heart, immediately alerting him to an intense and terrifying malice.
target: Ex profundis cordis Lato Guiaro, sensus frigoris effusus est, statim eum admonens de malitia intensa et terribili.

source: However, the source of this malevolence wasn’t the newly arrived demigod but the silver-gray behemoth trapped at the sea’s bottom—the very spaceship Lato Guiaro sought to obtain harbored ill intentions towards him!
target: Attamen, fons huius malitiae non fuit novus semideus, sed argentogriseus behemoth in fundo maris inclusus—ipsa navis spatialis, quam Lato Guiaro obtinere cupiebat, adversus eum malas intensiones habebat!

source: In the blink of an eye, the silver-gray behemoth retracted its authority.
target: In instante, argentogriseus behemoth suam auctoritatem retraxit.

source: Lato Guiaro’s status as the Governor of the Sea plummeted.
target: Status Lato Guiaro ut gubernator maris lapsus est.

source: Despite gaining a new boon, he couldn’t ascend to the demigod level.
target: Quamvis novum beneficium adeptus esset, ad gradum semidei ascendere non potuit.

source: The spaceship had betrayed him.
target: Navis spatialis eum proditus est.

source: This treachery was a result of the spell Cinderella had just unleashed—the Feast of Betrayal.
target: Haec proditio orta est ex incantatione, quam Cinderella modo dimiserat—Epulum Proditoris.

source: Its purpose was to temporarily awaken or bestow intelligence on a target item, compelling it to commit an act of “betrayal.”
target: Propositum eius fuit re destinatā temporarie excitare aut intelligentiam tribuere, coactionem efficens ut actum “proditoris” committeretur.

source: Lato Guiaro had seamlessly melded with the surrounding waters, harnessing the authority of the Governor of the Sea on a temporary basis.
target: Lato Guiaro facile se cum aquis circumstantibus contulit, auctoritatem gubernatoris maris pro tempore sumens.

source: The spaceship now stood as an entity he had yet to fully master.
target: Navis spatialis nunc stabat ut entitas, quam nondum plene dominari potuerat.

source: Objects beyond his full control were prime candidates for betrayal!
target: Res, quae extra eius plenam potestatem erant, candidatae optimae pro proditione erant!

source: “Cinderella” astutely sensed this vulnerability, initiating the Feast of Betrayal from the outset.
target: Cinderella callide hanc infirmitatem sensit, ab initio Epulum Proditoris inchoans.

source: Simultaneously, the sealed environment provided the perfect conditions for her to unleash this magic—an act she might not dare attempt elsewhere.
target: Simul, ambitus clausus condiciones perfectas praebebat ad hanc magiam liberandam—actum, quem alibi forte non ausus esset.

source: In that moment, surprise and fear flooded Lato Guiaro. It felt as though a frigid cascade had drenched him, sending shivers through his entire being.
target: In illo momento, stupor et timor Lato Guiaro inundaverunt; videbatur quasi cataracta frigida eum perfusam fecisset, per totum corpus suum tremores inferret.

source: Since merging with the sea and gaining the Governor of the Sea’s authority, Lato Guiaro had believed that ordinary Sequence 4 or even Sequence 3 demigods—commonly referred to as Saints—couldn’t swiftly overpower him in this realm.
target: Postquam cum mari coniunctus et auctoritatem gubernatoris maris adeptus est, Lato Guiaro credebat semideos ordinarios Sequence 4 aut etiam Sequence 3—ut saepe “Sancti” appellantur—celeriter eum in hoc regno superare non posse.

source: This belief created a sense of parity, but it hinged on him remaining within the waters to fully unleash his strength.
target: Haec opinio sensum aequalitatis creavit, sed pendebat ex eo quod intra aquas maneret ut virtutem suam plene efferret.

source: Yet, “Cinderella’s” mere magic stripped him of the Governor of the Sea’s authority, relegating him to Sequence 5. Without godhood, mastery over the sea slipped from his grasp.
target: Attamen, sola magica Cinderellae eum de auctoritate gubernatoris maris eripuit, ad Sequence 5 deprimens; sine divinitate, dominatio maris e manibus eius lapsa est.

source: Despite being a dual Sequence 5 of a potion and boon system with numerous unique abilities, Lato Guiaro harbored doubts about facing a genuine demigod.
target: Quamvis duplex Sequence 5 in systemate potionis et beneficii cum plurimis facultatibus singularibus esset, Lato Guiaro dubitationes de adversando verum semideo habebat.

source: A demigod temporarily shaped from an item proves fragile in the face of a true demigod.
target: Semideus, ex re aliquo tempore formatum, fragile se ostendit coram vero semideo.

source: So brittle that, once targeted, they wouldn’t endure even a breath… Lato Guiaro grappled with the stark realization of the fragility of a true demigod and sank into deep regret and despair.
target: Tam fragiles, ut, semel admossi, ne spiritum quidem sustinerent… Lato Guiaro acerrime intellexit fragilitatem veri semidei et in profundo paenitentiae atque desperationis statu cecidit.

source: At that moment, the silver-gray behemoth trembled violently, causing the energy passageway at the entrance to flicker and cast its luminance upon Lato Guiaro.
target: In illo momento, argentogriseus behemoth vehementer trepidavit, faciens ut introitus viæ energiae micaret atque luminis sui fulgorem in Lato Guiaro proiiceret.

source: With a whoosh, Lato Guiaro found himself hurtling uncontrollably into the spaceship through the pure energy conduit.
target: Cum impetu, Lato Guiaro se invenit irrumpere in navem spatialis per canalem energiae purum sine moderamine.

source: This was a facet of the spaceship’s calculated “betrayal,” aiming to turn the recent “authority holder” into a mere nutritive substrate within a petri dish!
target: Hoc erat pars navis spatialis consiliatae proditionis, quae recentem “auctoritatis possessorem” in solum substratum nutritivum intra vas petrae convertere volebat!

source: Lato Guiaro was initially startled, but soon a wave of joy washed over him.
target: Primum Lato Guiaro obstupefactus est, sed mox fluctus laetitiae eum inundavit.

source: An opportunity had presented itself!
target: Occasio apparuit!

source: It allowed him to infiltrate the spaceship, wrest control, and set it in motion—a chance to escape!
target: Id illi permisit navem spatialis infiltrare, imperium eripere, et eam in motum adducere—occasio ad effugiendum!

source: His misfortune and despair had suddenly transformed into this golden opportunity!
target: Infaustitas et desperatio eius subito in hanc auream occasionem conversa erant!

source: Observing the unfolding scene, Lumian wasted no time. He employed Spirit World Traversal once more, reaching the entrance of the energy passageway. Stepping in, he soared into the silver-gray behemoth.
target: Observans scaenam evolutam, Lumian nullum tempus amovit. Iterum Spiritus Mundi Transitus ad introitum viæ energiae adhibuit; ingrediens, in argentogriseum behemoth se immergit.

source: Mad Lady trailed closely behind, and Mr. K didn’t intervene; instead, he followed suit.
target: Mad Lady proximē sequebatur, et Mr. K non intervenit; sed ipse quoque secutus est.

source: Milo Village, Governor of the Sea’s residence.
target: Vicus Milo, domicilium gubernatoris maris.

source: Bard, strategizing an escape plan, was abruptly interrupted by cheers.
target: Bard, consilium evasionis excogitans, repente plausibus interpellatus est.

source: Cheers… Bard’s heart stirred, prompting him to dash out of the servant’s room towards the nearest glass window overlooking the dock.
target: Plaudite… Bard cor excitatus est, et statim constituit ex conclavi servorum versus proxima fenestra vitrea, quae ad portum aspiciebat, properare.

source: There, he observed the gathered villagers.
target: Ibi congregatos vicanos observavit.

source: Not a single sea spawn hindered the former Governor of the Sea during this process.
target: Ne una quidem creatura marina quondam gubernatorem maris in hoc processu impediit.

source: Many villagers raised their hands, seemingly welcoming the waves.
target: Multi vicani manus elevaverunt, quasi fluctus excipientibus.

source: As they praised the sea, an almost invisible glow descended, dispersing like water to different individuals.
target: Dum mare laudabant, fulgor paene invisibilis descendit, sicut aqua in varios homines diffusus est.

source: The nearby children joyfully shouted, “The sea prayer ritual has succeeded! The sea prayer ritual has succeeded!”
target: Proximī pueri laeti exclamaverunt: “Ritus orationis maris successit! Ritus orationis maris successit!”

source: That’s right, it has “succeeded”… Bard smiled.
target: Ita est, successit est… Bard subrisit.

source: From the looks of it, Ultraman and Mad Lady have succeeded.
target: Ex aspectu, videtur Ultraman et Mad Lady successisse.

source: The April Fool’s key member adjusted the collar of his crisp white shirt and hoisted a brown backpack onto his shoulders.
target: Membrum cardinale Aprilis Stulti collarem vestis albae nitidae temperavit et saccum fuscum super umeros attulit.

source: With an unabashed smile, he strolled into the grand hall of the Governor of the Sea’s residence, smoothly making his way out.
target: Cum absque pudore subrisus, in magnum atrium domicilii gubernatoris maris ambulavit et leniter exiit.

source: This time, he encountered no resistance.
target: Hoc tempore nullam resistentiam invenit.

source: The guards stationed at the entrance knelt on the ground, expressing gratitude to the sea for its boon.
target: Custodes, ad introitum positi, in terra genu flexerunt, gratiam maris pro beneficio suo exprimentes.

source: Bard took a detour to the docks, reveling in the genuine joy and praise for the sea.
target: Bard iter alternum ad molas cepit, gaudio vero et laude pro mari delectatus.

source: Every time he heard the townsfolk praising the sea and witnessed genuine smiles, his spirits lifted.
target: Quoties cives mare laudabant et risus sinceri apparuerunt, animus eius elevabatur.

source: These fools!
target: Hi stulti!

source: They are treating a catastrophe as a cause for celebration!
target: Catastropham quasi causam celebrationis agunt!

source: This is a prank, a prank on everyone in Port Santa… Bard closed his eyes in satisfaction and weaved through the crowd, heading deeper into Milo Village. His ultimate destination: the peaks of the Pyraez mountain range.
target: Hoc est iocus, iocus erga omnes in Port Santa… Bard oculos claudit ex satisfactione et per turbam serpens in Vicum Milo profundius se contendens. Eius ultima destinatio: cacumina montium Pyraez.

source: As a former Swindler, Bard orchestrated the sea prayer ritual operation, serving as its main planner. The plan’s success naturally brought him satisfaction.
target: Ut pristinus fallax, Bard operationem ritus orationis maris ordinavit, principalis eius consiliarius fungens; successus consilii naturaliter ei satisfactionem attulit.

source: Crucially, despite taking the most pivotal step in the entire operation, he assumed the least risk and exposure, avoiding direct confrontations.
target: Praecipue, quamvis maximum gradum in tota operatione cepisset, minimum periculum et expositionem tulit, directos congressus vitans.

source: Navigating through the mix of ancient and modern structures in Milo Village, Bard’s brow furrowed slightly.
target: Per mixturam antiqualium et modernarum structurarum in Vicus Milo navigans, supercilia Bard leviter contraxit.

source: A sense of unease settled upon him.
target: Sensus inquietudinis eum afflixit.

source: Per the initial plan, Ultraman—unhindered by strong opposition—was supposed to use the second command to open the energy passageway.
target: Secundum consilium initium, Ultraman, non impeditus a valida oppositio, mandatum secundum ad viam energiae aperiendam adhibere debuit.

source: Relying on his temporary authority as the Governor of the Sea, he aimed to secure safety for himself and Mad Lady within him.
target: Confidens in auctoritate temporaria gubernatoris maris, intendebat securitatem sibi et Mad Lady praestare.

source: Seizing the opportunity, he planned to eliminate all present and inflict severe injuries on potential demigod adversaries.
target: Occasionem arripiens, destinavit omnes presentes occidere et adversariis potentialibus semideorum graves iniurias inferre.

source: If powerhouses like Hela emerged and proved resistant to the humanoid Sealed Artifact, Ultraman—the interim Governor of the Sea—would leap into action, confronting the formidable foes head-on.
target: Si potentes ut Hela emerissent et adversus Artifactum Sigillatum humanoidem resisterent, Ultraman, gubernator provvisorius maris, in actionem saliturus esset, hostes formidabiles directe oppugnans.

source: Mad Lady, wielding her enchanted ring, would harness the potent energy emanating from the spaceship, transforming it into a boon for everyone present, extending its reach to all the Children of the Sea in Port Santa’s vicinity.
target: Mad Lady, anulo incantato gerens, potentem energiam ex navis spatialis effluentem congregabat, eam in beneficium omnibus praesentibus transformans, et vim eius ad omnes Filios Maris in vicinitate Port Santa extendens.

source: This strategic move not only allowed them to sidestep danger but also granted them access to the spaceship, enabling them to activate it.
target: Hoc consilium non solum eos periculum vitandi, sed etiam aditum ad navem spatialis obtinendi concedebat, ut eam activare possent.

source: Despite the fact that the people had already received the sea’s boon and a few minutes had elapsed, the spaceship remained dormant, and the sky showed no signs of change.
target: Quamquam populus iam beneficium maris accepit et pauca minuta transierunt, navis spatialis quieta manebat, et caelum nullas mutationis signa ostendebat.

source: What had transpired during this interval?
target: Quid in hoc intervallo evenit?

source: With this lingering question, Bard hastened his steps.
target: Haec quaestio manens, Bard celeriter ambulare coepit.

source: Tap, tap, tap.
target: Tap, tap, tap.

source: Behind him, the faint sound of light footsteps echoed once again.
target: Post eum, sonus levium vestigiorum pedum iterum resonavit.
